ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels limited to localized scarring and barnacle clusters, estimated ratio of 95:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark pigmentation across both lobes; isolated high-intensity circular pixel rings (rosettes) scattered mid-lobe; dense high-intensity textured clusters at distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at the fluke center with a narrow acute vertex angle and moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of valleys is more pronounced on the outer lateral regions compared to the perimedial region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast, ring-shaped pixel clusters (circular scars) distributed across the mid-section of both lobes; concentrated cluster on the upper-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of approximately 6-8 distinct, parallel, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the distal half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy high-relief barnacle colonization on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, significantly altering the peripheral pixel geometry.
